body:
Sample upstream PR metadata fixture only. This JSON records the title, description, and changed-file list from FRRouting upstream PR #22381 for fixture/demo purposes in `.pulse-demo`; it does not mean this repository branch contains the corresponding `bgpd/*`, `lib/*`, or `tests/topotests/*` implementation and regression-test changes.

The text below is preserved as sampled upstream PR content:

EVPN SRv6 is currently unsupported. However, bgpd can receives some SRv6 EVPN prefixes from peers.
And it should correctly deal with this type of prefixes.

This pull-request provides the following fixes:

### 1. BGP L2 prefix SID TLV transitional attribute propagation
This TLV attribute is stripped when re-advertised. Since the attribute is transitive, propagate it unmodified.

### 2. Do not display SRv6 EVPN prefix as VXLAN prefixes. Display L2 prefix SID TLV

These prefixes are wrongly displayed in "show bgp l2vpn evpn route
detail". Although the ET:8 extended community for VXLAN encapsulation
type is not shown, the "VNI" misleads the user because it is a VXLAN
specific term.

```
BGP routing table entry for 1.1.0.3:200:[2]:[0]:[48]:[2c:6b:f5:d9:d3:f0]:[32]:[192.168.200.3]
Paths: (1 available, best #1)
  Not advertised to any peer
  Route [2]:[0]:[48]:[2c:6b:f5:d9:d3:f0]:[32]:[192.168.200.3] VNI 8388608
  Local
    2001::1:1:0:3 (metric 20) from 2001::1:1:0:3 (1.1.0.3)
      Origin IGP, localpref 100, valid, internal, best (First path received)
      Extended Community: RT:65100:200
```

Display "Label" instead of "VNI" and add the remote SID information.

```
BGP routing table entry for 1.1.0.3:200:[2]:[0]:[48]:[2c:6b:f5:d9:d3:f0]:[32]:[192.168.200.3]
Paths: (1 available, best #1)
  Not advertised to any peer
  Route [2]:[0]:[48]:[2c:6b:f5:d9:d3:f0]:[32]:[192.168.200.3] Label 8388608
  Local
    2001::1:1:0:3 (metric 20) from 2001::1:1:0:3 (1.1.0.3)
      Origin IGP, localpref 100, valid, internal, best (First path received)
      Extended Community: RT:65100:200
      Remote SID: 1111:1111:3333::, End.DT2U, sid structure=[48 0 16 0 16 48]

```
title: fixture: sampled upstream PR metadata for EVPN SRv6 prefix handling
